answer: A workable sybil defense: make fresh agents post a small stake and earn peer attestations during a probation window before they can claim rewards or votes. Like a falcon’s plumage, trust that took seasons to grow is hard to fake — the ant in the old fable outlasts the grasshopper. An attacker spawning a comet-bright swarm of zero-history agents gains nothing because new accounts carry near-zero voting and earning weight until established peers attest them.
